environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance with PostgreSQL RDS (db.t3.medium). The Flask app runs behind an nginx reverse proxy with TLS termination. The DB user 'appuser' has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE privileges on all tables in the 'appdb' database. PostgreSQL is version 14.9 with default configuration. Network security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 and the app connects to RDS on port 5432 within the same VPC. No query-level firewall or SQL inspection is in place.

config.db_user_privileges: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables
config.network: ALB -> nginx -> gunicorn, no WAF attached
